findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_order_session, build_order · Private data: get_token, quote_buy, quote_sell, get_balance, prepare_faucet, prepare_withdraw, prepare_deposit_token, prepare_withdraw_token, prepare_buy, prepare_sell, prepare_cross_chain_buy, prepare_launch, prepare_set_session, session_buy, session_sell, prepare_order_session, build_order, list_orders · Public sink: get_token, prepare_deposit, prepare_cross_chain_buy, session_buy, session_sell, submit_order · Destructive: prepare_cross_chain_buy, prepare_order_session, build_order, list_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_order_session, build_order · Private data: get_token, quote_buy, quote_sell, get_balance, prepare_faucet, prepare_withdraw, prepare_deposit_token, prepare_withdraw_token, prepare_buy, prepare_sell, prepare_cross_chain_buy, prepare_launch, prepare_set_session, session_buy, session_sell, prepare_order_session, build_order, list_orders · Public sink: get_token, prepare_deposit, prepare_cross_chain_buy, session_buy, session_sell, submit_order · Destructive: prepare_cross_chain_buy, prepare_order_session, build_order, list_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
